b: Me (24M) and my girlfriend (22F) have been together for almost 2 and a half years. We are currently long in a long distance relationship but we try and see each other on the weekends since we live about an hour and a half from each other while she is still in college. I went out to see her last night to visit her and we went out to a bar with some of her friends. While I was getting a drink I noticed that she was having a conversation with a guy who looked like he was either in his 40s or 50s. This is not weird since she is very social and will talk to anyone about anything. I went over there to check on her and he had offered her to take a shot together. She accepted the shot which is not why i think she cheated but it was how they took the shot. He wanted her to take a body shot off of him. A body shot is basically where you lick their neck, put salt on it, lick it again to taste the salt, then you take the shot and grab a lime out of the other persons mouth with your mouth. So you are essentially kissing the other person while grabbing the lime out of their mouth after the shot. I wanted to intervene and do something but I didn’t realize what was going on until it was too late. I immediately left the bar because I was upset. By the time she got back that night I was already sleeping. This morning I wanted to have a conversation about it and I explained how I thought that was cheating and that it was disrespectful. She has been trying to tell me that it is not cheating because “it’s not like they had sex”. She has apologized for it and understands how it is disrespectful but she does not think that it is cheating because she was just having fun. I don’t know what to do now. I feel so hurt by this and feel very disrespected. How do I move forward? I don’t want to break up but It doesn’t feel like I will be able to get over it for a while and she is insisting she didn’t cheat.

Edit: I appreciate the comments but I did want to clarify something. She did apologize and she understands that it is disrespectful, she just keeps saying that it isn’t necessary cheating. I also don’t believe that she has done anything like this in the past. We make time to go see each other frequently and times we aren’t together we FaceTime every night.
